$description: Eidotter Design System - Tier 1 Primitives (DTCG Format). The CGA palette — universal across all platforms. Theme files (theme.*.tokens.json) override these values to produce mode variants (cga-amber, mode4-p0/p1, mode5). Tier 2 web semantics live in web.tokens.json. Tier 3 dimensions in dimensions.tokens.json. Tier 4 effect parameters in effects-params.tokens.json.

color.$description: Amber monochrome palette (default) - use themes for CGA color variant

cga-true.$description: Authentic CGA functional-status primitives (DMNC-1001). The default color.cga.* palette is amber-monochromed (green/red/cyan resolve to browns), so apps that need honest status colour cannot get it by aliasing it. This sibling group carries the original full-saturation CGA values and is THEME-INVARIANT (like color.semantic.text.aiDraft) — green is #00AA00 in every theme — so an app aliasing it gets the same honest colour regardless of the active DOS palette. Sourced from theme.cga-amber. The full rename/collapse rationalization is DMNC-922; this is the additive slice that unblocks cross-project app adoption (DMNC-1002). EXPOSURE: emitted as CSS custom properties (--color-cga-true-*) + a Figma Foundation primitive for cross-file aliasing — deliberately NOT a Tailwind utility (the tailwind/preset format walks only color.cga.*, and lint-token-refs rejects bg-cga-true-* on purpose). Web consumers use the semantic status tokens (amber-mono) or the raw CSS var; cga-true is for app/platform aliasing, not a general web colour. ACCESSIBILITY: cga-true/red #AA0000 on the near-black CRT background is ~2.3:1 — below WCAG AA body text (4.5:1). Use red as a fill (light foreground over it), not as error text on a dark background. green #00AA00 and cyan #00AAAA pass AA body on dark. See guidelines/figma-architecture.md adoption recipe.

green.$description: True CGA green — functional success / in-range.

red.$description: True CGA red — functional error / out-of-range.

cyan.$description: True CGA cyan — functional info / sensor.

white.$description: True CGA white — theme-invariant light foreground for functional fills (white-on-red destructive, white-on-green success). #FFFFFF on cga-true.red #AA0000 is ~5.9:1 (passes WCAG AA). DMNC-922.

redBright.$description: True CGA bright red — theme-invariant. The readable-as-TEXT-on-dark red (#FF5555 on the #020003 CRT bg passes AA, where the solid #AA0000 is only ~2.3:1). Use for error TEXT/icons on dark; use the solid `red` for fills. DMNC-922.

aiDraft.$description: AI-drafted prose, not yet revised by human — Signalnoise hot pink. Brand-locked hex: same value across all themes so the AI marker is unmissable regardless of palette. Lives in base (T1) so all themes inherit it; the rest of color.semantic.* lives in web.tokens.json (T2).

aiDraftGlow.$description: Phosphor halo around AI-drafted prose. 50% rgba of the aiDraft hex; brand-locked alongside it. Used in text-shadow only; no Tailwind utility.
